quotes.text: Coming right up: Belgian hybrid shower curtain and defense startup Aperture Science raises 780M Euros, while biotech unicorn Umbrella is on the verge of coming out of stealth and releasing a vaccine for cancer.
quotes.author: schmorptron
quotes.source: Hacker News — Europe's new robotics unicorn: Germany's RobCo hits $1B valuation
quotes.extraction_note: Perfect parody of VC hype naming — Aperture Science (Portal) + Umbrella Corp (Resident Evil) as if they were real raises. Standalone, punchy, genuinely funny.
